::: {#def-observational-unit .theorem}
## Observational unit

A sub-vector $\mathscr{O}_i$, $i\in\mathcal{N}$, of the random variables $\mathbf{V}$ such that

$$
\mathscr{O}_i\subset\mathbf{V},\qquad \mathscr{O}_i\cap\mathscr{O}_j=\emptyset,\quad i\neq j.
$$

In sections 1–3, and in the bipartite models of sections 5 and 6, the units exhaust $\mathbf{V}$: $\mathbf{V}=\bigcup_{i\in\mathcal{N}}\mathscr{O}_i$. In section 4, $\mathbf{V}$ also contains relational variables, which belong to no unit (C.24).
:::
